noticeLocalDesc: All 2FA keys are end-to-end encrypted with Argon2id and AES-256-GCM locally. Zero cloud uploads, 100% private and secure.
noticePasswordDesc: Your master password is never stored and cannot be reset if lost. Please keep it safe.
noticeBackupDesc: Data is stored strictly on this device. Regularly export encrypted (.sav) backups. Without a backup, lost or wiped data cannot be recovered!
unlockNoticeDesc: All 2FA data is locally encrypted end-to-end. Please keep your master password safe and backup regularly—lost data without a backup cannot be recovered.
unlockBackupDesc: Data is stored strictly on this device. Regularly export encrypted backups. Without a backup, lost or wiped data cannot be recovered!
